warning.titlePre: Land Rover Defender D350 DC-DC Converter & Timing Chain
paragraphs: Defender D350 engines with the Ingenium AJ300D — fitted across the L663 generation — are part of the Ingenium diesel family. The timing chain pattern is well-documented across this engine family, and the DC-DC converter failure pattern applies to mild-hybrid variants (which the D350 is). The DC-DC converter is a single point of failure for the entire 12V electrical system — failure causes complete loss of electrical power, sometimes while driving. We replace the DC-DC converter, timing chain components, injector seals, bearings and gaskets as standard on every AJ300D rebuild.
Early production D350s (2019-2020) also show electrical injector faults, which we inspect and replace as part of the rebuild.
warning.source: Source: verified via specialist buying guide (l663.guide), independently corroborated, per VRF-landrover-defender.md. Confirmed for AJ300D (D250/D300/D350) MHEV Ingenium variants. P300 (no MHEV) and Octa (BMW's own 48V hardware) explicitly excluded from this specific pattern
